# VOLI - The Volleyball Hub

> VOLI is a free volleyball app for iPhone and Android covering NCAA Division I women's volleyball, Major League Volleyball (MLV) and LOVB (League One Volleyball). Fantasy volleyball is its most-used feature. VOLI also has live scores and box scores, play-by-play for pro matches, team and player stats, the weekly VOLI Top 100 and each match's chance to win, the Volleyball Encyclopedia of honors back to 1979, and volleyball news and podcasts in one feed. VOLI is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by the NCAA, MLV, LOVB, the AVCA or any conference.

## What's in VOLI (as of October 2026)
- **Fantasy volleyball:** build a team from real college or pro players and play the season against your friends in a public or private league. Leagues use a salary cap and multi-round contracts, for NCAA Division I women's volleyball and MLV; the NCAA season runs in ten rounds, Wednesday to Sunday. Volleyball podcasts run their own public leagues on VOLI.
- **Live games:** scores and box scores for college and pro matches as they happen, with a lead chart for each set. Live Activities on iPhone.
- **Stats and box scores:** box scores for 99.8% of completed Division I women's matches since 2023 (nearly 500,000 player lines), and set-by-set player stats for all 445 MLV and LOVB matches. Leaderboards by season, conference, position and class, in totals or per set.
- **Play-by-play:** every MLV and LOVB match (445), with each rally, substitution and the rotation on court. College matches do not have play-by-play in VOLI.
- **Rankings and predictions:** the VOLI Top 100, VOLI's own ranking of Division I teams from match results and strength of schedule, published each Monday. Before first serve, each upcoming college match shows each team's chance to win and the most likely set score; during the match the chance to win updates after every set. The app also shows the AVCA Coaches Poll and EVOLLVE's team ratings.
- **The Volleyball Encyclopedia:** more than 18,000 honors back to 1979, including 3,000+ AVCA All-America selections since 1981, AVCA Players and Coaches of the Year, the AVCA Coaches Poll since 1982, all 45 NCAA champions, ACC, Big 12, Big Ten and SEC honors, record books, the MLV Draft and pro league honors.
- **News and podcasts:** volleyball news from 19 outlets (league and conference sites and independent writers), each story linked to its source, and 12 volleyball podcasts with more than 800 episodes to stream or download.
- **Community:** a chat room for every match, rooms for NCAA, MLV and LOVB fans, a private chat for each fantasy league, and AMAs with volleyball creators.
- **Analytics by EVOLLVE:** EVOLLVE's college volleyball analytics in the app: nightly team ratings for every Division I team, player impact numbers such as RAPM, and match predictions, labeled as EVOLLVE's.

## Products
- **VOLI app** (iOS and Android, free; 2.8k+ downloads as of October 2026)
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/voli-the-volleyball-hub/id6749812982
  - Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.playvoli.app
- **VOLI Discord bot:** live scores, standings, stat leaders, rankings, fantasy standings and pro transactions in Discord servers. https://playvoli.com/discordbot

## Leagues covered
- NCAA Division I women's volleyball
- MLV (Major League Volleyball), pro women's
- LOVB (League One Volleyball), pro women's
- Athletes Unlimited, in the history archive

## Partners
- Volley Talk with Sarah Pavan and The Major League Minute: volleyball podcasts that run public fantasy leagues on VOLI.
- EVOLLVE: college volleyball analytics. https://playvoli.com/evollve

## Data and independence
VOLI's match data comes from publicly available official box scores and schedules (and play-by-play for MLV and LOVB), processed by VOLI's own pipeline. Encyclopedia history comes from the published records of the AVCA, the NCAA, the conferences and the leagues. VOLI is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by the NCAA, MLV, LOVB, the AVCA or any conference.
